title: Desert meeting with 'the boys upstairs': four descending lights that turned out to be Marine flares
place_text: Desert near Joshua Tree / Twentynine Palms, California

tellings.quote: And we're out in the desert late at night and we see my mouth dropped open. Four lights slowly descending.

plain: Around 1978, Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychics and the afterlife, went out to the desert near Joshua Tree and Twentynine Palms, California, late at night with a companion named Valerie Ransone, hoping to meet what they called "the boys upstairs." He tells Michels his mouth dropped open when they saw "four lights slowly descending," which turned out to be flares dropped by the Marines.
